QuestInfo.name: To the Temple Once More
QuestInfo.0: You decided to work with the real Handsome Monk to save the town. Perhaps in your heart, you'd already decided that even before you said as much.
QuestInfo.1: The Handsome Monk has his part to play, and you have yours. It's time for round 2 of your showdown with the Monster Rat.
QuestInfo.2: You arrived at the Handsome Monk's Temple, discovering the miasma to be even thicker than before.
